definition: Fine-tuning a model with a reward model trained on human preferences, via reinforcement learning, to better follow instructions.
details: Human annotators rank several model outputs; those rankings train a reward model that then scores generations during reinforcement learning. InstructGPT showed this pipeline makes language models more helpful and less harmful than pure pre-trained models of the same size, and RLHF is a central technique in aligning modern assistants.

explainer.lead: RLHF fine-tunes a model with reinforcement learning against a reward model trained on human preference rankings. It is a central technique in aligning modern assistants, making them more helpful and less harmful than pure pre-trained models of the same size.

tiers.eli5: Like a dog trained by people who simply point at the better of two tricks — the dog learns what humans prefer, not a fixed rulebook.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers have annotators rank several model outputs, train a reward model on those rankings, then score generations with it during reinforcement learning. The InstructGPT pipeline showed this makes language models more helpful and less harmful than pure pre-trained models of the same size.
tiers.paperLevel: Human annotators rank several model outputs; those rankings train a reward model that then scores generations during reinforcement learning.

explainer.example: Annotators rank four answers to a prompt from best to worst; the reward model learns from those orderings and guides reinforcement learning toward preferred responses.

citation.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
citation.venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35 (NeurIPS)
